comments.author: home
comments.text:
2026-10-20 non-breaking audit pass, PR https://github.com/AnthusAI/Biblicus/pull/93 (not merged yet).

npm audit (apps/dashboard): before 103 total (7 critical, 54 high, 37 moderate, 5 low); after `npm audit fix` (no --force) 58 total (0 critical, 45 high, 13 moderate, 0 low). Only package-lock.json changed; overrides kept, no direct major bumps.
Dependabot (manifest apps/dashboard/package-lock.json): 80 open, 65 resolved by installed versions in the new lock, 15 remain (vite x3, tmp x2, uuid, esbuild x2, react-router x2, braces, csv-parse, mysql2, @graphql-tools/utils, postcss-selector-parser).

Still waiting on Amplify: @aws-amplify/data-construct and @aws-amplify/graphql-api-construct still bundle platform-core, plugin-types, backend-output-storage, ai-constructs, graphql-transformer, graphql-conversation-transformer (npm cannot override); @aws-amplify/graphql-generator, appsync-modelgen-plugin and graphql-types-generator pin old @graphql-tools/utils (patched 12.0.1) and the graphql-codegen chain; @aws-amplify/graphql-schema-generator pulls mysql2 3.9.9 (no fix published) and csv-parse 5.6.0. Not Amplify: braces has no published fix; vite 5->6.4.3+, tailwindcss 3->4, @cucumber/cucumber 10->13 and react-router 6->7.18 are major upgrades of direct dependencies. Status left as blocked.
